(def ^{:arglists '([f args] [f x args] [f x y args] [f x y z args] [f a b c d & args])} apply
  "Applies fn f to the argument list formed by prepending intervening arguments to args."
  (do
  ;; Sequence folding is adapted from Clojure 1.12.6 clojure/core.clj reduce1.
  ;; Copyright (c) Rich Hickey. EPL-1.0; see runtime/core-import/LICENSE.
  (declare Var)
  (suss.bootstrap/apply-sequence-ops!
    seq
    (fn [s] (-first s))
    (fn [s] (if (implements? INext s) (-next s) (seq (-rest s))))
    cons
    (fn [f] (satisfies? IFn f))
    (fn [f args]
      (cond
        (instance? MetaFn f)
        (suss.bootstrap/apply-to-seq (.-afn f) args)
        (and (suss.compiler/cell-defined? suss.core/Var) (instance? Var f))
        (suss.bootstrap/apply-to-seq ((.-val f)) args)
        :else (suss.bootstrap/apply-fixed f args)))
    count
    nth
    (fn [f initial remaining]
      (loop [value initial remaining remaining]
        (let [s (seq remaining)]
          (if (nil? s)
            value
            (if (implements? IChunkedSeq s)
              (recur (-reduce (-chunked-first s) f value)
                     (if (implements? IChunkedNext s)
                       (-chunked-next s)
                       (seq (-chunked-rest s))))
              (recur (f value (-first s))
                     (if (implements? INext s) (-next s) (seq (-rest s)))))))))
    (List. nil nil nil 1 nil))
    (fn
      ([f args]
        (let [n (suss.bootstrap/vector-count args)]
          (if (and (not (suss.bootstrap/nil? n)) (<= n 4))
            (cond (== n 0) (f) (== n 1) (f (nth args 0)) (== n 2) (f (nth args 0) (nth args 1)) (== n 3) (f (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2)) :else (f (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3)))
            (suss.bootstrap/apply-spread f args))))
      ([f x args]
        (let [n (suss.bootstrap/vector-count args)]
          (if (and (not (suss.bootstrap/nil? n)) (<= n 4))
            (cond (== n 0) (f x) (== n 1) (f x (nth args 0)) (== n 2) (f x (nth args 0) (nth args 1)) (== n 3) (f x (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2)) :else (f x (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3)))
            (suss.bootstrap/apply-spread f x args))))
      ([f x y args]
        (let [n (suss.bootstrap/vector-count args)]
          (if (and (not (suss.bootstrap/nil? n)) (<= n 4))
            (cond (== n 0) (f x y) (== n 1) (f x y (nth args 0)) (== n 2) (f x y (nth args 0) (nth args 1)) (== n 3) (f x y (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2)) :else (f x y (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3)))
            (suss.bootstrap/apply-spread f x y args))))
      ([f x y z args]
        (let [n (suss.bootstrap/vector-count args)]
          (if (and (not (suss.bootstrap/nil? n)) (<= n 4))
            (cond (== n 0) (f x y z) (== n 1) (f x y z (nth args 0)) (== n 2) (f x y z (nth args 0) (nth args 1)) (== n 3) (f x y z (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2)) :else (f x y z (nth args 0) (nth args 1) (nth args 2) (nth args 3)))
            (suss.bootstrap/apply-spread f x y z args))))
      ([f a b c d & args]
        (let [f (suss.bootstrap/apply-callee f)]
          (suss.bootstrap/apply-spread f a b c d (spread args)))))))
rationale: Native apply passes realized prefixes and normalized seq tails to ABI spread entries without ClojureScript arity-property reads. Source spreads retain exact next-only RestFn/AFn preflight and extraction, and ordinary nil-tail IndexedSeq adapters. Small vectors keep their positional path. Private per-instance callbacks root sequence operations, callable-object delegation, count/nth and numeric folding. MetaFn and Var delegate already-normalized arglists without an extra seq call; MultiFn retains the inherited AFn traversal observed on JVM 1.12.6. The fold adapts Clojure 1.12.6 clojure/core.clj reduce1 (EPL-1.0, Copyright Rich Hickey; https://github.com/clojure/clojure/blob/clojure-1.12.6/src/clj/clojure/core.clj), full source SHA256 66952fe1b060c086804cdfd9e9863277a020fb0cfe27167e709ce75e955ed72c, with protocol-based chunk reduction and next. EPL notice is retained in generated source and runtime/core-import/LICENSE. Native-family lazy entries and complete verification remain separate from this source adaptation.
